ensure-cf-project.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw staging-calendars || npx wrangler pages project create staging-calendars --production-branch main

deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/calendars --project-name staging-calendars --branch main

manual-deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/calendars --project-name staging-calendars --branch main

ensure-cf-project:production.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw production-calendars || npx wrangler pages project create production-calendars --production-branch production

deploy:production.command: npx nx build calendars --configuration=production-env && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/apps/ui/calendars --project-name production-calendars --branch production
